justification: Real production write: applying the merged, tested section-divider extraction fix (PR #1046) to already-LIVE content. Not Critical: a single, well-characterised chapter recommit, backed up first, with a documented before/after diff already produced and reviewed BEFORE this branch was created (as part of PR #1046's own regression testing). Not Minor: it changes already-served regulatory content, not wording.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reused the exact, already-tested scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py CLI (--chapter --all, no new code) -- this exact recommit's outcome was already predicted and verified via diff during PR #1046's own full-batch regression check, before this branch existed. No new script, no direct SQL for the write itself.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: N/A -- the diff this recommit would produce was already computed and inspected in PR #1046 (3 unchanged, 1 changed, 1 removed); this branch executes exactly that already-verified change, nothing more.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Targeted update (not full replace): 1 of 5 rows updated (1_1, divider prefix removed), 1 of 5 removed (2_1, was 100% divider junk), 3 unchanged (2_2, 2_3, preamble).
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A -- reads the same already-proven-reachable PDF from R2 used throughout this investigation.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before this write: a planner reading chapter-11-15-marco-avenue's '2.1 Objectives' saw only leftover divider text (a fake provision with no real regulatory content), and '1.1' opened with an unrelated table-of-contents fragment before its real text. After: the fake provision is gone and 1.1 opens with its real content (a residual map-label artifact remains in 1.1, a separate, deferred defect, not claimed to be solved here).

break_it.repro: SELECT count(*) FROM regulatory_provisions WHERE source_council='canterbury_bankstown' AND is_current=TRUE -- should read 188 (189 - 1 removed), matching exactly the 39-chapter total minus one net removal.
